description: Department of Labour - The Cost of Living Index Number for the Month of April, 2015 applicable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade is 178.5 and the Special Allowance payable to workers in the above trade in respect of a normal working day in the Month of May, 2015 will be Rs. 550.46
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the declaration of the Cost of Living Index Number and the corresponding special allowance for workers, made under the authority of the Wages Boards Ordinance. The content primarily involves the publication of a regulatory framework and compliance requirement (wage adjustments based on a statutory index), which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it names a government official (Dr. Satharasinghe), it does so only in their capacity to fulfill a regulatory function under existing legislation, and the core content is about implementing a legal/regulatory requirement rather than government personnel or structural changes.
